pool.english: The north of Iraq is mountainous and green.
The south is hot and flat.
Baghdad is in the centre of Iraq.
The west is mostly desert.
Iraq has eighteen governorates.
The Euphrates passes through Karbala and Nasiriyah.
The Tigris divides Baghdad into two halves.
The plain between the two rivers is fertile.
Iraq's climate is hot and dry.

pool.arabic: سكان العراق أكثر من أربعين مليون.
pool.arabicTashkeel: سُكّان العِراق أكثَر مِن أربعين مَليون.
pool.english: Iraq's population is more than forty million.
pool.transliteration: sukkaan il-3iraaq akthar min arba3een malyoon.

pool.arabic: العراق إله حدود ويا ست دول.
pool.arabicTashkeel: العِراق إلَه حُدود ويّا سِت دُوَل.
pool.english: Iraq has borders with six countries.
Agriculture depends on the rivers.
Basra has big oil fields.
Life in the countryside is simple.
The soil here is very fertile.
In the north it snows in winter.
The people of the south are famous for their generosity.
The centre has the most population.
Anbar is in the west of Iraq.
Basra Governorate is in the far south.
The Euphrates comes from Turkey.
We sat on the bank of the Tigris.
The Mesopotamian plain is wide.
The climate in the north is milder.
Most of the population is young.
The borders with Iran are long.
Date palms are the most important agriculture in the south.
Oil fields provide most of the money.
My grandparents live in the countryside.
Fertile land near the river.
Tourists love the north in summer.
The marshes are in the south.
Life in the centre is busy.
The western desert is huge.
Which governorate are you from?
The Tigris and Euphrates meet at Qurna.
Wheat grows in the northern plain.
Climate change affects the rivers.
The population of Baghdad is about nine million.
We crossed the border to Jordan.
Agriculture needs water.
Workers at the oil field.
The countryside is quiet and beautiful.
Fertile land and enough water.
Mosul is the biggest city in the north.
From the north to the south.
Karbala and Najaf are in the middle Euphrates region.
The governor of the governorate.
The Tigris is lower this year.
A green plain.

A growing population.
Closed borders.

The countryside and the city.

sentences.arabic: العراق متقسم لثمنطعش محافظة، وكل منطقة إلها طبيعتها.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: العِراق مِتقَسِّم لثْمنطَعَش مُحافَظة، وكُل مَنطِقة إلها طَبيعتها.
sentences.english: Iraq is divided into eighteen governorates, and each region has its own nature.
sentences.transliteration: il-3iraaq mitgassim l-thmunta3ash mu7aafadha, w-kull mantiga ilha tabee3atha.

sentences.arabic: الشمال جبلي، مناخه أعدل وبيه ثلج بالشتا.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الشَّمال جَبَلي، مَناخَه أعدَل وبيه ثَلِج بالشِّتا.
sentences.english: The north is mountainous, with a milder climate and snow in winter.
sentences.transliteration: ish-shamaal jabali, manaakha a3dal w-bee thalij bish-shita.

sentences.arabic: الوسط سهل خصب بين دجلة والفرات.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الوَسَط سَهِل خِصِب بين دِجلة والفُرات.
sentences.english: The centre is a fertile plain between the Tigris and the Euphrates.
sentences.transliteration: il-wasat sahil khisib been dijla w-il-furaat.

sentences.arabic: الغرب صحرا كبيرة، والجنوب بيه الأهوار والنخل.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الغَرب صَحرا كْبيرة، والجَنوب بيه الأهوار والنَّخَل.
sentences.english: The west is a huge desert, and the south has the marshes and palm trees.
sentences.transliteration: il-gharb sa7ra chbeera, w-ij-janoob bee il-ahwaar w-in-nakhal.

sentences.arabic: أغلب حقول النفط بالجنوب، خصوصا بالبصرة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: أغلَب حُقول النَّفُط بالجَنوب، خُصوصاً بالبَصرة.
sentences.english: Most of the oil fields are in the south, especially in Basra.

sentences.arabic: الزراعة مهمة، بس تغير المناخ دا يأثر عالأنهار.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الزِّراعة مُهِمّة، بَس تغَيُّر المَناخ دا يأثِّر عالأنهار.
sentences.english: Agriculture is important, but climate change is affecting the rivers.
sentences.transliteration: iz-ziraa3a muhimma, bas tghayyur il-manaakh da y2aththir 3al-anhaar.

sentences.arabic: دجلة والفرات يلتقون بالقرنة، شمال البصرة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: دِجلة والفُرات يِلتَقون بالقُرنة، شَمال البَصرة.
sentences.english: The Tigris and the Euphrates meet at Qurna, north of Basra.
sentences.transliteration: dijla w-il-furaat yiltagoon bil-gurna, shamaal il-basra.

sentences.arabic: سوية يسوون شط العرب، اللي يروح للخليج.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: سْوَيّة يْسَوّون شَط العَرَب، اللي يْروح للخَليج.
sentences.english: Together they form the Shatt al-Arab, which flows to the Gulf.
sentences.transliteration: swayya ysawwoon shatt il-3arab, illi yrooh lil-khaleej.

sentences.arabic: الأرض اللي حواليهم أخصب أرض بالبلد.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الأرض اللي حَوالَيهُم أخصَب أرض بالبَلَد.
sentences.english: The land around them is the most fertile in the country.

scenario.situation: The student is looking at a map of Iraq with an Iraqi geography teacher and asking about the different regions.
scenario.studentRole: A curious learner of Iraqi Arabic.
scenario.otherRole: A geography teacher who loves Iraq's landscapes.
scenario.goalEnglish: Ask about each region (north, south, centre, west), the rivers, the climate, the population and the economy (agriculture and oil), and where your Iraqi friends come from.
